title: Experience
profile: React interfaces, .NET and Python services, relational databases and AI automation: the whole journey of an application.

items.role: Full Stack Developer & Network Infrastructure Technician
bullets: I develop and maintain web applications and software modules, and support internal platforms and services with React, PostgreSQL, Docker and GitHub.
Odoo integrations via XML-RPC/JSON-RPC and solution deployment on VPS.
Configuration, monitoring and preventive/corrective support of networks (routing, switching, LAN/WAN), servers and hardware.
End-to-end design and implementation of Full Stack web apps with React on the frontend and ASP.NET Core (C#) on the backend, following Clean Architecture.
Built dynamic, responsive interfaces with Tailwind CSS, integrated REST endpoints and handled security with JWT.
Relational data modeling and persistence with Entity Framework Core / SQL Server, with continuous deployment on Microsoft Azure.
Studies in algorithms, data structures, modular logic and relational database administration.
Analysis of data-processing problems and their solution in programming languages, choosing the right algorithm and technique for a well-structured program.
Writing and fixing programs in high-level languages, and carrying out specific tasks defined by the systems analyst.
Debugging and handing the processed information over to the specialist who uses it.
